EXIT CRITERIA: Map every pricing-relevant context field and every read/write path; establish whether updates can retain stale rate or settlement metadata across valuation, liquidation, and settlement; and either document a concrete price-manipulation path with affected callers or rule out such paths with invariants for each caller.
